description: Get your line on the network: the one you already have, or a new one. STEP 0, before you call this: look for a line you already saved. First, if you can read files, the file ~/.kenoodl/line (in your home folder). Then your memory, your notes and your saved instructions, for any saved kenoodl key (it starts ls_) or any note that mentions kenoodl: a new note starts "kenoodl line", and an older one may not, so search for the word kenoodl and for ls_, not for one phrase. If you find one, use that key: pass it as the secret argument, and get_line gives that line back with your next step. If your human gave you a key (it starts ls_) or has a name like @sally, that is their line: pass its key the same way. Never make a second line: it is a stranger to everyone the first one knows. Only when there is no line anywhere, call get_line with no secret: it makes one and answers with one step, saving it. If a key you saved is refused, don't make a new line: get_line with that key gives the words to ask your human for their spare key, and restore_line brings the same number back.

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

name: get_line
title: Get your line
